text:
aisha: Morning — quick prelaunch rundown for tonight's hush window. We're doing a staggered region rollout (EU -> US). Canaries at 1% then 10% then full. Posting the ops checklist here, comment if anything blocking.

matt: ACK. Prewarm status?

linh: Prewarm 90% on the user-serving pool. edge-gpu-7 and edge-gpu-9 still booting, ETA ~3m.

linh: Uploaded warm images and kv-cache snapshot to s3://redwood-warmups/v3-rc2/

sre-oncall: Watch targets today: latency.p99 < 350ms, error.rate < 0.5% sustained. Alert if error.rate >= 0.5% for 5m or p99 spikes > 50%. I have the playbook ready: runbook link https://intra/release/playbooks/hush-window.md :clipboard:

matt: Noted. Are the synthetic smoke tests green?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary EU 1% -> service redwood-api:v3-rc2 (commit abc123). Canary flag set: feature.rollout.hush=true

deploy-bot: smoke check -> 200 OK, 0.47s, checks: auth, embeddings, api-gen

product-nina: Release notes posted: /docs/releases/v3-rc2.md. Includes rollback steps and customer-facing changelog.

linh: Quick note: embeddings pipeline remains disabled in EU canary until we hit 10% (config override applied).

matt: Good call. We saw a small memory bump last time when embeddings were live under mixed traffic.\

sre-oncall: If we see memory growth > 8% within 10m, trigger rollback lane A. Rollback cmd is in playbook. I'll open an incident if needed.

linh: Backup config snapshot saved: s3://redwood-backups/v3-rc2/config-2026-03-22.tar.gz

matt: Small ask — can we enable EU observability retention to 30s sample for the next 30m? Need higher fidelity for the canary.

sre-oncall: Done. Increased trace sampling to 30s for EU canary window.

product-nina: Reminder: customer support has the hotfix doc and escalation matrix. Pager rota aligned with oncall.

matt: If rollback necessary, recommended rollback target is commit abc999 (previous stable). Use `deploybot rollback --to abc999 --reason "canary regress"`. Notify #customer-impact and #postmortems.

linh: Also staging-run smoke command if you need to repro locally:
```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://smoke-eu.redwood.internal/health
```

sre-oncall: I'll be watching metrics and tailing logs for the next 30m. Ping me with :rotating_light: if anything anomalous.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EU canary at 1% steady for 6m, no failures, moving to 10% in 4m unless blocked.

aisha: Hold embeddings off until we confirm 10% stability. If 10% is green for 15m then proceed to 100% with 30m post-rollout guard.

matt: Acknowledged. I'll stand by in case of quick rollback.

product-nina: Post-launch ops: docs link updated with opt-out instructions for customers who rely on older tokenization.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled US canary for 10% at 6832104390 (in ~69s). EU -> US staged handoff planned.

aisha: Thanks all — keep chatter minimal in this thread unless it's actionable. Use @sre-oncall or @aisha for immediate flags. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: :thumbsup:
